title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Who We Are
Heritage is building the Modern Investment Office, supporting some of the most prominent families globally to achieve their capital enhancement and preservation goals.
Our vision is to help clients build enduring wealth across generations by combining institutional-grade investment sourcing with personalized portfolio construction, cutting-edge technology, and deep sector expertise. We aim to make sophisticated private market opportunities and modern wealth solutions more transparent, connected, and actionable.
Our team comprises a diverse international group of individuals from leading organizations and with diverse backgrounds, including private equity, venture capital, banking, software development, law, and entrepreneurship. We are committed to attracting top-notch talent and providing opportunities for growth and development based on their individual strengths and interests.
Your Role
Your role as Portfolio Manager is part of our Portfolio Management team. The mission of the role is to ensure that the portfolios of our UHNW clients are actively monitored, well-constructed and aligned with their objectives.
The Associate is allocated to a defined group of European client relationships, covering OCIO and portfolio advisory mandates. Portfolios are multi-asset, spanning liquid and semi-liquid investments, often across multiple banks and counterparties. The role carries direct ownership of portfolio oversight, from asset allocation, fees, liquidity and risk to the quality of the investments proposed to clients.
The role reports to Head of Portfolio Management, and cross-reports to the Relationship Managers. It works in close collaboration with both, providing RMs with timely, high-quality investment input and the confidence that their clients are being taken care of even when they are not looking.
Key Responsibilities

• Oversee client portfolios for OCIO and portfolio advisory clients, playing an active role in shaping clients’ portfolios across a range of asset classes (fixed income, public equity, alternative assets...)

• Maintain clear visibility on asset allocation, fees, liquidity and risk across client portfolios

• Monitor performance, attribution and risk metrics, identifying portfolio drift, concentration risks and misalignment with client objectives

• Assess investments and opportunities proposed by banks and other counterparties (funds, structured products, discretionary mandates, alternatives), forming clear and well-reasoned views

• Identify sub-optimal products (fees, quality, overlap) and propose better alternatives

• Support Relationship Managers with timely, high-quality investment input ahead of and following client discussions

• Track transactions, changes and next steps, so that monitoring and follow-up actions are not missed

• Support business development meetings with prospective clients

• Work closely with the Portfolio Management team on portfolio construction and investment decisions, with a view to contributing to the continuous improvement of our investment process
What We Are Looking For

• Outstanding academic background with a master's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or related disciplines

• Solid experience in portfolio management or advisory, ideally for UHNW individuals, within a Multi-Family Office, OCIO, Private Bank or Wealth Manager

• Strong grasp of portfolio construction and asset allocation, including strategic vs tactical allocation and diversification principles, and the ability to assess multi-asset portfolios (liquid and semi-liquid)

• Ability to analyze investment products proposed by banks and asset managers, with a solid understanding of fees (explicit and implicit), liquidity terms and risk drivers

• Experience monitoring portfolio performance, attribution and risk metrics

• Comfortable interacting with sophisticated UHNW clients and Relationship Managers, and able to explain investment concepts clearly and credibly, both verbally and in writing

title: Security Analyst Internship
description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways. We help organizations build skills and stay compliant through a high-quality content catalog, seamless LMS/LXP integrations, and advanced capabilities like skills-based curation and multilingual content creation. More than 2,000 companies, including 150+ of the Global 2000, rely on OpenSesame to develop the world's most productive and admired workforces.
Learn more:  www.opensesame.com/about

Internship Overview

OpenSesame seeks passionate, driven students to join us for a paid summer internship program. Suppose you’re intelligent, curious, and full of fresh ideas. In that case, this is your chance to collaborate with an exceptional team and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment.

As a Security Analyst Intern, you’ll work on real-world compliance and security challenges, contribute to impactful solutions, and collaborate with teams across OpenSesame to strengthen our security and compliance posture.

About the Security and Compliance Team

At OpenSesame, our Security and Compliance Team ensures our company meets the highest industry standards and regulatory requirements. We focus on compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 42001 and other security frameworks, vendor risk assessments, incident response, and policy enforcement.

Our team partners across departments to mitigate risks, respond to security threats, and maintain a strong security culture. Through continuous learning and innovation, we protect the organization and help drive secure business growth.

Performance Objectives

2 Weeks

• Gain hands-on experience with GRC compliance tools such as Drata and security tools such as Crowdstrike.

• Learn how to leverage Claude and AI features for creating vulnerability dashboards and reports. 

• Shadow team members to understand security and compliance workflows.

• Become familiar with JIRA, Confluence, and other project management tools for tracking compliance-related tasks and projects. 

30 Days

• Assist in collecting and reviewing technical security evidence for audits and tracking.

• Support security initiatives, including phishing simulations, email security, and pen-testing programs.

• Learn compliance features of our SAST tooling for tracking and reporting vulnerabilities.

• Propose and develop workflow automations to streamline GRC and security operations.

60 Days

• Take ownership of assigned security projects, contributing independently to deliverables.

• Become comfortable owning several audit evidence collection tasks in Drata.

• Assist in analyzing vulnerability findings and tracking remediation efforts.

• Gain hands-on familiarity with AWS cloud security operations and vulnerability assessments.

• Must be a current student enrolled in a college/university program or have graduated within the past 12 months (undergraduate, postgraduate, or associate programs accepted)

Compensation:

Fully Remote Role: Interns must have access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection during working hours. OpenSesame will provide a company laptop for use throughout the internship, which must be returned at the conclusion of the internship.

title: Junior Sourcing Specialist
description:
About the role: What’s in the Box

You will join our European Strategic Sourcing Team, which buys the ingredients and products behind millions of HelloFresh meals across multiple markets. Our ambitious team is growing and we have several junior roles open within the Procurement team, each with its own focus.

You don’t need to pick a specific position upfront. During the process, we’ll get to know your strengths and interests and discuss together where you’d fit best. Whichever role you take, you’ll learn how international procurement works from start to finish and help make sure our customers get high-quality products at the right cost, every week.

Please note: For junior positions, we are unable to offer visa or work permit sponsorship, either now or in the future. To be considered, you must have the legal right to work in your preferred location.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

• Support procurement strategies and plans across our European markets, working closely with experienced colleagues in the team.

• Analyse supplier offers, cost data and market prices to build cost models and spot savings opportunities.

• Monitor market trends and supply risks, using data and Generative AI tools to support pricing forecasts and decisions.

• Identify and assess suppliers, prepare negotiations and take ownership of selected suppliers as you gain experience.

• Collaborate with product, culinary, food safety and quality, and operations teams to bring new products to our customers on time.

• Contribute to cross-functional procurement projects and keep local and global stakeholders up to date on progress.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree, for example in business, supply chain, engineering, or food science.

• Up to 2 years of experience in procurement, supply chain or a related field. Exposure to the food industry is a plus.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data in Excel or Google Sheets.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to build relationships with suppliers and colleagues across teams, countries and functions.

• A proactive, organised mindset. You take initiative and enjoy learning quickly in a fast-moving environment.

• Excellent English. Another European language is a plus, as is a willingness to travel occasionally within Europe.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What we offer: The Toppings

Our benefits vary by country. Here is a taste of what you can expect:

• Tasty discounts : generous discounts on HelloFresh and our other brands, plus savings with partner brands.

• Learning & growth : internal training, and mentoring opportunities

• Flexibility : a hybrid working setup

• A warm welcome : an onboarding program and a dedicated manager

• Wellbeing : discounted fitness memberships and access to mental health and mindfulness apps.

• Financial security : a company pension scheme and commuting support, depending on your location.

• Great people : team events, Friday drinks and a lively office culture.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

title: Volunteer, Operations - China Country Team

Overview
The Clinton Health Access Initiative , Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.
CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.
At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. title: Radar Engineer
description:
Location: Onsite - Austin, TX

Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time

Job Title: Radar Engineer

About 9 Mothers

The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the

tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we

aren’t just "innovating"-we are building the shield.

Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and

neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power,

counter-drone system built for the edge-on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack.

Why 9 Mothers?

While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate

survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven

builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see

your code or hardware in the field next month-not next year-this is your playground.

Position Summary

9 Mothers is hiring a Radar Engineer to own the radar sensing layer of our counter-sUAS

kill chain. In this role, you will integrate and tune radars from multiple vendors so that their

detections and tracks feed cleanly into our platform-alongside our passive acoustic

(Vor) and in-house visual detection stack-giving Edda and future systems an earlier,

more reliable picture of incoming threats.

You will own the full radar lifecycle: characterizing sensors, writing the software that

ingests and processes radar data, tuning radar configurations for performance against

small, fast, low-RCS targets in cluttered environments, and validating that performance

on the range. This role sits at the intersection of RF engineering, embedded and real-time

software, and systems integration in a fast-moving defense startup environment.

Radar Engineer - Job Description (Draft)

Page 1 of 5

Essential Duties

Radar Characterization: Run bench and range characterization of the radars we field

(e.g., FMCW, pulse-Doppler, electronically scanned arrays) to verify vendor

performance claims and establish baselines for tuning.

Radar Integration: Integrate multiple radar models into our counter-drone platform,

including mechanical/electrical interfaces, timing and synchronization, coordinate-

frame alignment, and vendor SDKs, APIs, and data protocols.

Software Development: Design, build, and maintain the software that configures

radars and ingests, filters, and publishes their detections and tracks to the rest of our

system in a reliable, low-latency manner.

Performance Tuning: Tune radar parameters-waveform and mode selection,

detection thresholds, CFAR, clutter maps, Doppler filtering, and track

initiation/maintenance-to maximize probability of detection and minimize false

alarms against small, fast sUAS in real-world environments.

Sensor Fusion Support: Work with the perception and controls teams to fuse radar

tracks with acoustic and EO/IR data, and to cue our visual tracking and effectors from

radar.

Testing & Validation: Build and execute test plans, including simulation, hardware-in-

the-loop, and live-flight range testing with our UAS pilots, and establish metrics for

detection range, track quality, latency, and false-alarm rate.

Field & Customer Support: Support radar setup, site surveys, and tuning during

customer demonstrations, pilots, and field deployments, troubleshooting issues from

the RF front end through the software stack.

Documentation: Produce and maintain integration documentation, interface control

documents (ICDs), tuning guides, and test reports for internal teams and external

partners.

Requirements

Radar Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience as a radar engineer, radar systems

engineer, or similar role, including work with more than one radar type or vendor.

Integration Track Record: Demonstrated experience integrating radars into larger

systems (vehicles, fixed sites, C-UAS, air defense, autonomy, or similar)

title: Contracts Specialist
description:
Transforming The Way Construction Owners Use Technology & Data

Avicado is known for best-in-class service to our clients, and our contracts are the backbone of that delivery. Solid contracts set the terms, expectations, and guardrails that let our teams do great, uninterrupted work. As Avicado grows, the Contracts Specialist is one of the key support pillars that keeps that backbone strong. You keep our contracts reviewed, signed on terms we can stand behind, easy to find, and easy to understand, so Finance, our consultants, Sales, and leadership can do their work with confidence.

Core Responsibilities

Contract Review and Risk Screening

• Act as the first-line reviewer for contracts, amendments, and RFPs from Sales and internal teams, including client, partner, vendor, and IT agreements.

• Identify the terms that carry real risk, say what each could cost us, and recommend how to respond, including redlines within our standard positions.

• Coordinate redlines and approvals between Sales and leadership, and elevate terms outside our standard positions, so every contract has a clear status and a clear next step.

• Support internal teams with risk questions on software and IT agreements and client security questionnaires.

• Own the insurance requirements in contracts: be the first stop for internal questions, coordinate the annual insurance renewal with our broker, and back up the Biz Ops Coordinator on certificate of insurance (COI) requests.

Contracts Database and Lifecycle

• Build and maintain the central Contracts Database. A contract is not done until it is stored with its key dates, terms, and obligations.

• Keep the data accurate and complete: check entries regularly, fix errors at the source, and document how entries are made so teammates can add to the database correctly.

• Record renewal, notice, and termination terms when a contract is stored, so Sales, who own renewals, know the terms, the paper the contract is on, and whether anything new needs to be put in place.

• Own the termination process: when Directors or Sales decide to end an agreement, review the contract if its terms are not already in the database, define how it gets terminated, and hold the team accountable for the steps.

• Grow what the database captures over time so the team can answer questions about terms and obligations without reopening the contract, and so leadership can see risk in aggregate across all of our contracts.

Templates

• Own our contract templates: decide what goes into them, get our Legal team's feedback, and update the templates once a change is approved.

• Maintain the template change request process so every request gets a clear answer and the requester can see its status.

• Keep one current version of each template in one place, and make sure out-of-date copies are not in use.

• Work with Sales so they understand which terms carry little risk and can be adjusted, and which carry operational or business risk and should not change without review.

• Identify template gaps and get them closed.

Ideal Background

• Hands-on experience reviewing professional services agreements, such as MSAs, SOWs, and change orders, ideally in a consulting or implementation environment.

• Working knowledge of common risk terms: indemnification, limitation of liability, SLAs, data and privacy, and insurance requirements.

• Experience building or maintaining a contract repository or tracker and keeping it accurate over time, not only using one.

• Experience carrying a template or process change through to adoption across teams that do not report to you.

• A calculated view of risk: you size it, recommend a response, and let decision-makers weigh it against the value of the deal, rather than treating risk as something to avoid or forwarding every contract to counsel.

• Experience working with an outside law firm or in-house counsel.

• Create and present regular reports on GRC performance, risks, and compliance status to senior leadership and stakeholders.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or in an engineering/STEM field

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 5+ years of security compliance or technology audit-related experience.

You will be responsible for productizing our AI capabilities, turning technology into measurable business value.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Cards
locationText: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
description:
As the story goes, in 1949 Frank McNamara finished dinner at a New York restaurant and found he'd left his wallet in another suit. His fix was a card that let members eat now and pay later. That card became Diners Club, widely credited as the first multipurpose charge card. It was a piece of cardboard and a promise: the restaurant trusted the card, the card trusted the member, and someone had to make sure the money actually moved.

More than seventy-five years later, the promise hasn't changed, but the machinery has. When a Mercury customer taps their card, the request goes from the merchant's terminal through an acquirer and a card network to us. In a fraction of a second, we check the balance, apply the customer's spend controls, screen for fraud and say yes or no. After that comes clearing, settlement, disputes and reporting, and every cent has to reconcile.

Cards are the way Mercury customers spend money. The Cards Integration team owns the whole Mercury card, not just the swipe: issuance, physical card shipping, spend controls, lifecycle management, authorization, money movement, settlement and reporting, and the infrastructure underneath. We're a full-stack team, and our job is to make the Mercury Debit and IO cards reliable, correct, useful, and innovative.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thinks deeply about systems architecture, cares about the customer experience, and will dive into any problem to move the team forward. We value high ownership, working in pairs and teams rather than alone, and attention to detail. Those matter when you run systems held to four nines of reliability, and everyone around you will care about them too.

In this role, you will

• Lead projects from idea to tech spec to implementation to launch, working with your PM, EM, tech lead, and teammates at each stage. When you lead a project, it's yours to see through.

• Learn how debit and credit cards actually work under the hood (authorization, clearing, settlement, disputes) and use that knowledge every day.

• Build features across the stack, from the card experiences customers use to the backend systems that move money.

• Help keep our operations excellent. Our systems are some of the most observable at Mercury, and with great observability comes great responsibility.

• Mentor other engineers and raise engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and collaboration.

• Work with product, design, operations, risk, compliance, sales, and many other teams.

You should

• Have strong full-stack experience, a product mindset, systems thinking, and a knack for getting things across the line.

• Have made architectural decisions on complex systems, and be able to explain your reasoning and the trade-offs.

• Be excited to put new features in customers' hands, and care just as much about keeping existing ones working like a charm.

• Care about correctness in systems where failure has real financial consequences.

• Communicate clearly, handle ambiguity well, and enjoy mentoring others.

• Be comfortable with our tech stack (Haskell and TypeScript) or be ready to learn.

• Bonus: experience in fintech, payments, or card issuing.

We encourage you to try our demo site if you're interested in applying for the role.

Join PatientPoint to be part of a dynamic team creating change in and around the doctor’s office. As a leading digital health company, we innovate to positively impact patient behaviors. Our purpose-driven approach offers an inspirational career opportunity where you can contribute to improving health outcomes for millions of patients nationwide.

Location: New York (Hybrid) or Remote
Travel Required: Less than 10%
Job Summary
PatientPoint ’s Programmatic Operations Manager is a crucial role focused on managing and optimizing programmatic advertising initiatives. This role involves working with internal teams and external partners to ensure the successful execution of programmatic campaigns to maximize revenue. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, platform expertise, and a proactive approach to performance management and troubleshooting
What You’ll Do

•
Manage Programmatic Deal Operations : Oversee the entire programmatic deal workflow, from set-up, execution, reporting, and optimizations. Responsible for identifying process improvements to enhance effectiveness of programmatic operations.

•
Campaign Management: Responsible for monitoring campaigns across various programmatic platforms to ensure accurate campaign delivery and performance against KPIs. Identify, investigate, and resolve issues related to deal health.

•
Data Analysis & Reporting : Regularly review and analyze campaign performance data within dashboards and reporting frameworks to deliver actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders.

•
Partner Management : Build and maintain relationships with AdTech Platforms, notably SSPs and key stakeholders and disseminating internal communications to staff and volunteers.

What We Need

• 5+ years of AdOps experience with PMP and Direct deal management

• Hands-on experience setting up and managing programmatic deals directly within SSPs and DSPs.

• Possess a strong understanding of programmatic, targeting, and AdTech platforms and technologies.

• Experience working at large scale, premium publisher

• Experience with DOOH or extreme curiosity to learn fast

• Strong analytical skills for campaign optimization and performance analysis. Proven ability to analyze data sets and effectively communicate findings.

• Proficient with major SSPs and ad servers.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Exceptional organizational and communication skills.

• Proactive and resourceful, with a strong sense of initiative.

• Collaborative with a positive attitude.

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

Base Salary Band: $60,000.00 - $110,000.00
Compensation: At PatientPoint , we are committed to providing competitive pay and benefits that are in line with industry standards. We analyze and carefully consider several factors when determining compensation, including skills, qualifications, geographic location, and professional experience, which can cause your compensation to vary. The base salary range listed is just one component of PatientPoint ’s total compensation package for employees. For additional details on our total benefits package, please review the section “About PatientPoint ” at the end of this job description.

description:

We operate within the Architecture, Engineering, Construction, and Operations (AECO) industry, serving as the fastest-growing integrated collaboration platform. Our solution utilizes cloud and video gaming technology to support 2D and 3D workflow streams, enabling users to communicate and work with all project stakeholders in a unified environment. Revizto facilitates real-time coordination, automated clash detection, and issue tracking throughout a project’s lifecycle, helping thousands of global companies minimize rework and make informed decisions.

description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale - unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data - securing and protecting private information more effectively - Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

At Elastic, we have a simple goal: to pursue the world's data problems with products that delight and inspire. We help people around the world do extraordinary things with their data. From stock quotes to Twitter streams, Apache logs to WordPress blogs, our products are extending what's possible with data, delivering on the promise that good things come from connecting the dots. Often, what you can do with our products is only limited by what you can dream up. We believe that diversity drives our vibe. We unite employees across 30+ countries into one unified team, while the broader community spans across over 100 countries.

Elastic, makers of the hugely popular open source products Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash, and Beats, is growing very fast and so is our marketing team. As a key member of the Marketing AI, Operations and Automation team, you will play a hands-on, critical role in governing and administering the marketing AI tool stack that teams across the organisation depend on. From configuring tools at the system level to reviewing AI-generated content before it goes live, you will be the operational backbone that keeps marketing AI running consistently, safely, and at scale.

Elastic is looking for a flexible and adaptable person with the ability to manage a variety of governance and administration responsibilities across a growing set of AI tools and platforms. • Maintain the internal prompt library, approved-use guidelines, and minimum starting prompts available to marketers across the organisation.

• Partner with the Marketing AI Engineer to onboard new tools and workflows through the appropriate approval processes.

• Surface tool-level usage patterns and review volume to inform resourcing and governance decisions as the team scales.

• Assist in maintaining internal documentation across team knowledge bases, wikis, and the playbooks.

• Hands-on experience working with at least one enterprise AI or generative AI platform at an organisational level, such as Jasper, Writer, or Adobe Firefly.

• Demonstrated understanding of system-level prompt architecture and how AI configuration affects output quality and consistency across teams.

• Strong process orientation with the ability to build governance workflows and documentation standards from scratch.

• Familiarity with Marketo, Workfront, or similar enterprise marketing platforms.

• Clear, precise written communication and strong attention to detail.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager (Strategic Alliances)
description:
At Affirm , we exist for the moments that matter-giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

As a Senior Technical Account Manager (Senior TAM, L6) at Affirm , you will own the operational aspect of technical account management across Affirm 's strategic alliance portfolio-alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, delivering against SLAs, fielding technical inquiries, and performing investigations and analysis, while also driving technical initiatives that translate merchant business objectives into technical strategies and product optimizations. Senior TAMs are part of the Engineering team and collaborate closely with Affirm 's Product, Engineering, Operations, Customer Success, and Frontline Technical Support teams.
This is an operations-heavy role to start. Expect the majority of your early focus to be on keeping merchant integrations healthy-monitoring, triage, troubleshooting, and SLA delivery-while you progressively take on more custom solutioning and cross-functional initiatives. Over your first 6-12 months, as you build operational mastery, you will grow into owning your own book of accounts and carrying it through to end-to-end account ownership.
A Senior TAM independently owns operational health across the strategic alliance portfolio, designs custom integration solutions grounded in Affirm 's standard integrations, drives cross-team collaboration on initiatives, acts as a technical lead on team projects, and mentors less-experienced members of the team.
What You'll Do

• Own the operational aspect of technical account management across Affirm 's strategic alliance portfolio-alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, and fielding technical inquiries-so integrations stay healthy and issues are resolved quickly.

• Deliver against SLAs, proactively surfacing technical risks before they become customer-impacting and responding with urgency to merchant issues.

• Perform in-depth investigations and root-cause analysis across logs, queries, and integration data, owning resolution end to end and escalating to cross-functional partners or executives when needed.

• Drive technical initiatives and partner with internal and merchant stakeholders on launch initiatives-expansions, promotions, new product adoption, and integration optimizations-that grow the value of the accounts after launch.

• Design and deliver high-scope, often-custom integration solutions grounded in Affirm 's standard integrations-combining, extending, and tailoring them to complex, open-ended problems while balancing speed, quality, maintainability, reliability, and scalability.

• Act as a technical lead for internal projects, defining and delivering well-scoped milestones and executing the project roadmap.

• Operationalize best practices by creating and updating playbooks, runbooks, alerting, and UAT certification plans across the strategic alliance portfolio and continuously reduce keep-the-lights-on (KTLO) work.

• Partner with Product and Engineering leads to identify, plan, and prioritize projects based on team goals and resources, acting as the voice of the merchant to influence the roadmap.

• Mentor and level up less-experienced TAMs, share learnings from your integrations and investigations, and contribute to interviewing and team development.

• Over your first 6-12 months, grow into owning a dedicated book of strategic alliance accounts-carrying operational ownership through to end-to-end account ownership.

What We Look For

• Professional Background: at least six years in a technical, external-facing role such as Technical Account Management, Solutions/Partner Engineering, or Solutions Architecture-ideally within FinTech, payments, or SaaS-with a demonstrated track record of owning the operational health of technical accounts and delivering against SLAs.

title: Power Automate Engineer
description:
Born in Yosemite, forged in Quantico and built for adventure. 5.11 is a purpose-driven lifestyle brand, rooted in performance, durability, and versatility. Since 1979, we’ve created gear and apparel for people who live life without limits, delivering gear and apparel that empower them to push boundaries every day.
We’re looking for an experienced Power Automate Engineer to lead and enhance automation across our enterprise systems, retail operations, and global ecommerce platforms.
In this role, you'll own and expand our automated regression testing suite, ensuring critical business systems remain reliable through software updates and new releases. You'll also manage existing business process automations, develop new solutions, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve efficiency and system performance.
What You'll Do:
Automation & Regression Testing

• Own, maintain, and enhance automated regression testing using Microsoft Power Automate.

• Execute regression testing for major Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) and Commerce releases, providing results and recommendations to support release decisions.

• Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve automation failures while improving test reliability and execution efficiency.

• Expand automated testing across enterprise operations, retail point-of-sale systems, ecommerce integrations, and Adobe Commerce storefronts.

• Partner with development teams and product owners to translate business requirements into automated test cases.

• Manage test environments, data, and scheduled automation runs to ensure consistent performance.

Power Automate Development & Support

• Manage and support existing Power Automate workflows and production automations across the organization.

• Design, build, and implement new automations to improve business processes and operational efficiency.

• Serve as the organization's Power Automate subject matter expert, providing technical guidance and establishing best practices.

• Administer Power Platform environments, connections, service accounts, licensing, and deployment processes.

• Maintain clear technical documentation, testing procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

• Monitor automation performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and report results to IT leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with ecommerce, IT, product owners, internal developers, and external technology partners.

• Support system enhancements and software releases through effective testing and issue resolution.

• Communicate testing results, technical challenges, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What You Bring:

• 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, test automation, or automation engineering, including 3+ years managing automated regression testing.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Automate, including cloud flows, desktop flows, UI automation, error handling, and unattended execution.

• Experience testing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and Dynamics 365 Commerce POS, including major system upgrades.

• Experience developing, maintaining, and supporting production business process automations.

• Strong understanding of automated test design, regression testing strategies, and troubleshooting.

• Experience with Azure DevOps, including work items, test plans, and pipelines.

• Working knowledge of APIs, application logs, browser developer tools, and SQL for troubleshooting and validation.

description:
Avalere Healthについて
私たちは、「すべての患者さんに可能性を届ける」という共通の目的のもとで働いています。Avalere Healthは、すべての患者さんが必要な治療、支援、ケアを等しく受けられることを目指しています。Advisory、Medical、Marketingの各チームがそれぞれの専門性を生かして連携し、ヘルスケアが障壁とならず、誰一人取り残されない未来を築いています。
このミッションを実現するためには、社員一人ひとりが目的意識を持ち、患者さんの人生に具体的な変化を生み出せる環境が必要です。私たちは、多様なバックグラウンドやスキルを生かし、自分らしく働きながら、世界中の患者さんのために力を発揮できる文化づくりに取り組んでいます。
私たちは柔軟な働き方を大切にしています。各グローバルチームは、チームやクライアントのニーズに応じて、オフィス勤務または在宅勤務を選択できます。ロンドン、マンチェスター、ワシントンD.C.、ニューヨークの主要拠点に加え、世界各地のオフィスが、必要な時にチームが集まるコラボレーション拠点となっています。在宅勤務の社員にも、交流の機会や必要なリソースを提供しています。
インクルーシブな文化は、私たちのすべての活動の中心にあります。Diverse Ability、Family、Gender、LGBTQ+、Mental Health、Race/Ethnicityの6つのEmployee Network Groupを通じて、社員が自分らしく働ける環境を支援しています。これらのグループは、定期的なミーティングや活動を通じて、多様性、公平性、インクルージョンを促進し、つながり、学び、交流する機会を提供しています。また、私たちはFertility Friendly認定企業として、不妊治療に関する方針、充実した育児休暇制度、柔軟な働き方を通じて、家族形成のあらゆる段階にある社員を支援しています。
日々のキャリア経験、数千に及ぶオンデマンド研修、定期的なキャリア対話、グローバルかつ部門横断的なキャリア機会を通じて、社員の継続的な成長を積極的に支援しています。

ポジションについて
Avalere Healthのグローバルマーケティング部門で、クライアント案件の日々の進行を支えるアカウントエグゼクティブを募集します。クライアントパートナーシップ、プロジェクトマネジメント、クリエイティブ、ストラテジーなどのメンバーと連携し、案件が予定どおり、正確かつ円滑に進むよう調整するポジションです。
会議の準備や議事録、進捗・アクション管理、ブリーフ作成の支援、承認状況の確認など、案件運営の土台となる業務を担当します。細かな点まで丁寧に確認し、リスクや課題を早めに共有しながら、自分の担当業務を着実に前へ進めることが求められます。
入社後は、クライアント業務を通じて、アカウントマネジメントの基礎を実践的に身につけていただきます。周囲の支援を受けながら担当範囲を広げ、将来的にはクライアントとのやり取りや、より複雑な案件進行にも関わっていただくことを期待しています。

Avalere Health Japanでは、柔軟な働き方と、社員一人ひとりが能力を発揮できる職場環境を大切にしています。
休暇・福利厚生制度については、日本法人の雇用条件および社内規程に基づいて提供します。
また、グローバルネットワークとの協働、継続的な学習機会、専門性を高めるためのサポートを通じて、社員の成長とキャリア開発を支援します。

title: Staff Security Researcher, Vulnerability Research (Emergent Threat Response & Me
description:
Rapid7 's vulnerability intelligence team does industry-leading offensive research that helps organizations worldwide understand and prioritize real risk. When a critical vulnerability starts getting exploited in the wild, we're the team that figures out what's actually happening, how bad it is, and what defenders need to do about it. We're looking for an experienced vulnerability researcher to help lead that work, with a strong focus on rapid n-day analysis and on making Metasploit better for the security community.

About the Team
Rapid7 vulnerability researchers analyze high-priority n-day vulnerabilities, write Metasploit modules, find and publish zero-day vulnerabilities, and help customers, the media, internal teams, and the public understand which threats matter and why. We drive Rapid7 's company-wide Emergent Threat Response (ETR) program, coordinating our research, product coverage, and customer guidance when widespread attacks hit. We aren't satisfied with being purely reactive, though. We also look for the vulnerabilities and attack patterns that will become tomorrow's widespread threats.

About the Role
This role sits at the Staff level, a senior technical leadership position on our individual contributor track. Your time will be focused primarily on Emergent Threat Response and Metasploit, with zero-day research as a secondary focus.

Primary focus: Emergent Threat Response (n-day research)

• Rapidly analyze newly disclosed and actively exploited vulnerabilities, often under tight timelines, to determine root cause, exploitability, and real-world impact

• Reproduce vulnerabilities and build working exploits from patch diffs, advisories, and limited public information, documenting behavioral differences across affected versions and platforms

• Publish clear, technically rigorous root cause analyses that help defenders act quickly and reflect Rapid7 's attacker-focused approach to vulnerability intelligence

• Advise detection and vulnerability check engineers as they build coverage, and help internal teams and customers understand what's urgent, what isn't, and why

• Serve as a go-to expert during high-velocity events (think Log4Shell), knowing when to raise alarms and when to counsel patience

Primary focus: Metasploit

• Develop and contribute high-quality exploit modules to Metasploit, especially for high-priority vulnerabilities coming out of ETR work

• Drive improvements to the Metasploit Framework itself, including new capabilities, tooling, library enhancements, and quality improvements that make the framework more effective for researchers and practitioners

• Review community and internal module contributions, raising the bar for code qua

• lity, reliability, and stability across the project

• Partner with the Metasploit engineering team on roadmap priorities and help shape where the framework goes next

Secondary focus: Zero-day research

• Identify and research, new vulnerabilities in technologies that matter to enterprise organizations

• Help define longer-term research priorities with the broader team, bringing a point of view on emerging attack surface

Across all of it

• Contribute technical trend analysis to Rapid7 's research reports and publications

• Represent the team's work through conference talks, webcasts, blog posts, and media engagements

• Mentor and develop other researchers through code review, pairing, documentation, and technical guidance

• Explain technical risk clearly to audiences ranging from engineers to executives

The skills and qualities you'll bring include

• Demonstrable expertise across most major vulnerability classes and exploitation techniques, with the ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and attacks quickly and effectively

• Experience developing complex exploit chains from scratch, including from patch diffs or minimal public detail

• Strong reverse engineering and binary/code diffing skills, including against large codebases or binaries

• Expert-level

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager, Data Center Infrastructure, Electrical & Mechanical
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Industrial Compute organization is building the infrastructure needed to support the next generation of AI. We work with engineering firms, construction partners, utilities, equipment manufacturers, and strategic suppliers to deliver hyperscale campuses.

The Strategic Sourcing team develops the supplier relationships and commercial strategies that help these programs secure critical equipment, manage long-lead constraints, and deliver reliably at scale. We partner across Design Engineering, Infrastructure Delivery, Capacity Planning, Construction, Finance, Legal, and Hardware Operations.

About the Role

We are seeking a Strategic Sourcing Manager to lead sourcing strategy for electrical and mechanical infrastructure systems across Industrial Compute campuses. You will develop supplier and commercial strategies, negotiate agreements, and align supplier capacity with technical requirements and deployment plans.

The role spans both electrical and mechanical categories. Candidates should bring deep sourcing expertise in at least one discipline, with enough cross-functional fluency to partner effectively across both. Relevant backgrounds may include hyperscale data centers, mission-critical facilities, industrial construction, semiconductor manufacturing, or energy infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop sourcing strategies for critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure systems.

- Lead supplier selection, RFx processes, negotiations, and contract execution for major infrastructure programs.

- Build strategic relationships with manufacturers, EPC firms, integrators, and infrastructure suppliers.

- Partner with Engineering and Infrastructure Delivery to align commercial decisions with technical requirements, project schedules, and deployment priorities.

- Coordinate with Capacity Planning on long-term supplier capacity, lead times, and infrastructure roadmaps.

- Evaluate suppliers’ manufacturing capacity, quality, financial health, delivery performance, and operational maturity.

- Identify and mitigate supply risks through supplier diversification, capacity reservations, long-term agreements, and alternative sourcing strategies.

- Monitor market conditions, manufacturing trends, commodity impacts, and other factors that could affect cost or delivery.

- Establish supplier scorecards and performance measures for quality, cost, schedule, responsiveness, safety, and execution.

- Develop market analyses, supplier benchmarks, financial models, and scenarios to support sourcing decisions.

- Partner with Finance and Legal to structure scalable agreements and sourcing governance.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Construction Management, Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field.

- 8+ years of experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, supplier management, or infrastructure supply chain.

- Experience sourcing major infrastructure systems, industrial equipment, or equipment for large capital projects.

- Demonstrated success negotiating complex commercial agreements with strategic suppliers.

- Strong understanding of supplier qualification, contract strategy, performance management, and sourcing governance.

- Experience partnering with engineering, construction, finance, legal, and operations teams.

- Strong analytical, financial modeling, negotiation, and executive communication skills.

- Deep sourcing experience in electrical or mechanical infrastructure, plus the ability to work across the other discipline.

Preferred Skills

Experience sourcing one or more of the following categories:

- Electrical: substation and transformer equipment; medium- and low-voltage distribution; switchgear; busway; UPS; protection, control, and monitoring systems; prefabricated electrical skids and e-houses.

- Mechanical: modular cooling plants; chillers; heat exchangers; pumps; VFDs; air- and water-cooled systems; dry or adiabatic coolers; CRAH/CRAC units;

title: Senior MarTech Manager
description:
About Us
At Prenuvo , we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".
We're looking for a Senior MarTech Manager to set the technology and operational strategy behind our marketing programs. This person will define how marketing strategy, data, systems, and execution connect, ensuring our tools work together, data is trustworthy, and teams can scale their use of technology to acquire, engage, and retain customers.
The ideal candidate operates at both altitudes: setting a multi-year MarTech strategy and architecture direction, while staying close enough to the stack to make sound build-vs-buy and integration calls. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant influence over cross-functional priorities, vendor spend, and technical direction, partnering closely with Marketing, Data, Product, and Engineering leadership.
Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!
What You’ll Do

• Set strategy and own architecture decisions for the MarTech stack, including build-vs-buy calls and vendor relationships.

• Define and drive a multi-year roadmap for marketing technology, automation, analytics, and personalization.

• Direct the platform strategy for CRM, marketing automation, CDP, analytics, attribution, experimentation, and customer engagement tools.

• Architect data flows between marketing systems, product systems, CRM, and the data warehouse, and set the standards other teams build against.

• Establish and enforce governance standards for tracking, campaign setup, lifecycle management, and data quality across the org.

• Partner with Marketing, Growth, Data, Product and Engineering leadership (Director/VP level) to translate business strategy into scalable technical solutions.

• Identify and lead automation initiatives that materially reduce manual campaign operations.

• Own the technical foundation for segmentation, lifecycle marketing, personalization, and reporting.

• Lead vendor evaluation, selection, and contract negotiation; own implementation and adoption outcomes.

• Build documentation, governance frameworks, and processes that make the MarTech ecosystem scalable and auditable.

• Monitor system performance, data quality, and operational risk, and escalate/resolve complex issues before they become team-wide blockers.

• Provide technical direction and mentorship to marketing ops or MarTech staff, even without formal reporting lines.

What You’ll Bring

• 8-12 years of experience in marketing technology, marketing operations, growth operations, or a related field, with a track record of owning strategy, not just execution.

• Demonstrated experience setting technical direction and influencing decisions at the Director/VP level.

• Deep expertise across CRM, marketing automation, customer data platforms, analytics, and integrations.

• Hands-on experience with tools such as Salesforce/HubSpot, Braze/Iterable, Segment, GA4, GTM, Snowflake/BigQuery, Zapier, Workato, OneTrust, and related platforms.

• Strong SQL, API, and data integration fluency, with the judgment to know when to build vs. delegate.

• Track record managing cross-functional projects, external vendors, and budget/spend decisions.

• Executive-level communication skills, able to translate technical tradeoffs for non-technical leadership.

• Comfortable setting direction in ambiguity, without waiting for complete information.

Nice-to-Have

• Experience building or modernizing a MarTech stack

Reporting to design leadership, the role focuses on upholding brand and corporate identity consistency across all print and paid marketing channels, driving customer acquisition and perceived product quality through innovative, detail-oriented design work. Also to contribute to our ongoing efforts to drive business success and enhance customer satisfaction.

What you’ll do

•
End-to-End Packaging Design: Conceptualize and execute high-quality packaging for private-label ingredients and outer boxes, crafting an engaging in-box experience from concept to completion.

•
Vendor & Print Supervision: Partner with third-party production houses to recommend materials and paper solutions, oversee printing, and enforce technical file and print quality standards.

•
Brand & Quality Control: Uphold brand identity guidelines, deliver creative excellence, and review all content for meticulous grammar, spelling, and visual accuracy.

•
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with global operations, procurement, local market stakeholders, and Creative Operations to incorporate feedback and hit tight deadlines.

•
Workflow & Project Management: Manage incoming requests, prioritize workloads, and guide design projects through every stage of production under strict timelines.

•
Innovation & Sustainability: Monitor competitor benchmarks, industry trends, and printing advancements to implement modern, sustainable packaging solutions.

What you’ll bring

•
Education & Professional Experience: Bachelor’s degree with at least 4 years of dedicated packaging design experience within an agency environment (food and beverage experience is strongly preferred).

•
Software & Project Tools: Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) alongside team collaboration and project management tools like Jira, Slack, and Sprout.

•
Print Production & Technical Expertise: In-depth knowledge of print processes, CMYK, and Pantone systems, with proven ability to generate technical drawings, instructions, and material specification packs from concept through final production.

•
Design Systems & Visual Craft: Strong foundation in typography, design systems, and visual storytelling, demonstrated through a comprehensive portfolio of print, packaging, and graphic design work.

•
Stakeholder & Project Management: Exceptional organizational, communication, and time-management skills to align with multiple stakeholders, manage concurrent projects, and meet tight deadlines.

•
Creative & Detail-Oriented Mindset: Strong conceptual and analytical thinking paired with meticulous attention to detail for error-spotting, brand consistency, and high-quality creative output.

Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. title: Machine Learning Performance Engineer
description:
We are looking for an engineer with experience in low-level systems programming and optimisation to join our growing ML team. 

Machine learning is a critical pillar of Jane Street's global business. Our ever-evolving trading environment serves as a unique, rapid-feedback platform for ML experimentation, allowing us to incorporate new ideas with relatively little friction.

Your part here is optimising the performance of our models - both training and inference. We care about efficient large-scale training, low-latency inference in real-time systems and high-throughput inference in research. Part of this is improving straightforward CUDA, but the interesting part needs a whole-systems approach, including storage systems, networking and host- and GPU-level considerations. Zooming in, we also want to ensure our platform makes sense even at the lowest level - is all that throughput actually goodput? Does loading that vector from the L2 cache really take that long?

If you’ve never thought about a career in finance, you’re in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you’ll fit right in. 

There’s no fixed set of skills, but here are some of the things we’re looking for:

• An understanding of modern ML techniques and toolsets

• The experience and systems knowledge required to debug a training run’s performance end to end

• Low-level GPU knowledge of PTX, SASS, warps, cooperative groups, Tensor Cores and the memory hierarchy

• Debugging and optimisation experience using tools like CUDA GDB, NSight Systems, NSight Computesight-systems and nsight-compute

Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Position Summary

In this role, you will lead the day-to-day performance of Metrea's on-site 24/7 Point of Contact Centre in Greece. You will direct Service Desk, Network and Cybersecurity, and Aviation Application Support analysts; control work across shifts; and act as the senior operational escalation point for service disruption. You will be successful if you combine people leadership, service management and sound operational judgement with clear customer communication.

What You'll Do

• Lead the on-site centre and maintain effective operational control across all shifts and support disciplines.

• Build and maintain rosters that provide the approved coverage, competence, access and escalation support.

• Monitor incident queues, alerts, backlogs, response times, resolution performance, aged work and customer communication.

• Set shift priorities, rebalance work and act as the senior operational escalation point for priority and major incidents.

• Coordinate analysts, specialist teams, suppliers and customer representatives during service disruption.

• Manage analysts through objectives, one-to-ones, performance reviews, coaching, wellbeing support and development plans.

• Maintain a competency matrix and control duties and system access according to demonstrated capability.

• Own the junior rotational programme, including mentors, rotation objectives, reviews and second-year specialisation recommendations.

• Review ticket quality, handovers, knowledge, process adherence and service performance, and report risks and improvement actions.

• Maintain operating procedures, major incident arrangements, business-continuity playbooks and compliance with security and site requirements.

What You Bring

Must Haves

• Proven line-management experience in a service desk, IT contact centre, NOC, SOC or application-support operation.

• Experience leading a 24-hour, shift-based or high-availability service and managing coverage, handovers and escalation.

• Broad practical understanding of end-user support, networks, cybersecurity, infrastructure, identity and business applications.

• Experience managing incidents, service levels, backlogs, major incidents, customer escalations and suppliers.

• People-management experience covering onboarding, objectives, coaching, performance, wellbeing and development.

• Strong written and verbal

title: Sales Representative, Schoolytics (Remote, US)
description:
Why You'll Love This Role:
As a Sales Representative, Schoolytics by EveryDay Labs (SbE) you will be part of a regional sales team and the overall face of Newsela in the small-medium business market. You’ll be responsible for building relationships with key decision makers at the district level, driving new business and expansion. This role will focus on selling Newsela ’s suite of products including assessment, data warehousing, and MTSS tools.
In your day to day, you will do everything from pipeline management and forecasting, to designing lead generation campaigns and managing sales through the entire lifecycle. You will also become well-versed in your territory’s funding, state initiatives, demographics, and K-12 education landscape, which will help inform your overall sales strategy.
What You'll Be Doing:

• As an individual contributor who is part of a regional sales team, you will have the opportunity to own your territory, manage the entire lifecycle of a sale, and build new business relationships that bring Schoolytics’ solutions to classrooms.

• Take ownership of developing territory business plans, evaluating funding landscapes, and tailoring sales strategies to align with district initiatives.

• In addition to achieving your own revenue targets, you will get to work with an enthusiastic, cross-functional team to catapult Schoolytics’ growth as we scale our national sales organization.

• Meet virtually with school and district leaders, presenting solutions, negotiating terms, and securing agreements that bring Schoolytics into classrooms.

• Have a direct impact on the expansion and adoption of Schoolytics products, which will ultimately scale Newsela ’s ability to bring engaging, culturally responsive learning content to K-12 classrooms nationwide.

• Thrive in a role that requires significant autonomy, representing the company in the market, making recommendations that impact strategy and results, and managing priorities independently.

• Exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance, including evaluating customer needs, structuring tailored solutions, negotiating within established guidelines, and influencing revenue and business outcomes.

About You:

• 2+ years of full-cycle (prospecting through closing) K-12 EdTech sales experience, with a track record of hitting or exceeding large sales quotas, required .

• Specifically experience selling core curriculum, Assessment, Data warehouse, and/or MTSS in the K-12 EdTech market required.

• A true prospector who is willing and able to build a book of business from scratch, with extensive experience in networking, prospecting, pipeline generation, and proven success forecasting business in the EdTech industry.

• Demonstrated experience as a strategic territory manager with the executive presence to lead consultative district conversations, navigating multiple stakeholders, and engineering the right solution for each customer.

• Experience with high-volume district sales, with proven experience building a book of business from scratch.

• A self-starter with a proven ability to drive sales quickly to a close and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Highly organized, adaptable to change, a fast learner who hits the ground running, maintains high service standards, and meets established sales goals in an agile environment.

• Excited by opportunities to connect face-to-face to meet with customers and prospects. Travel is estimated to be around 25%, depending on business and customer needs.

• Open to working flexible hours to meet customer and business needs; Majority of accounts in Eastern and Central time zones.

• Experiencing using AI tools to drive greater efficiency and productivity.

• Legally authorized to work in the US.

This role is classified is an exempt salaried role and is not eligible for overtime.

title: Jr Account Executive
description:
ABOUT US

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role

We're looking for a natural Sales person who is passionate about hospitality. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market.

In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more.

What You’ll Do

Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate:

- Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about

- Create engaging ways to show our product

- Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter

- Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully

- Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection

- Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel

- Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path

What You’ll Need

You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry:

- Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

- Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

- Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

- Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

- A minimum of 1 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality

- You are comfortable working in both English and Danish

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Flexible time off

- Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: (Senior) IT Support Specialist (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters - keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your Responsibilities

- Serve as the first point of contact for Level 1 tickets and ad-hoc helpdesk requests covering hardware, software, and workplace services across Statista's global workforce.

- Take ownership of incoming requests from qualification through resolution or escalation, ensuring timely updates, complete English documentation, and SLA compliance.

- Identify recurring issues and report patterns to the Workplace Manager to drive continuous improvement of IT services.

- Build and maintain self-service resources such as knowledge base articles, how-to guides, and FAQs, and identify automation opportunities for recurring tasks.

- Collaborate closely with Tech Ops and DWO team members on escalations, knowledge transfer, and documentation to ensure seamless handoffs.

- Support end-to-end IT onboarding for new colleagues and contribute to cross-team projects that improve IT services and workplace infrastructure.

Your Profile

- Completed IT training (e.g., IT specialist for system integration) or equivalent practical experience

- Initial professional experience in IT service or helpdesk environments

- Experience with identity and access management solutions (e.g., Microsoft 365 administration, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta - Statista uses Okta) and endpoint management tools such as Microsoft Intune

- Experience working with ITSM ticketing systems (Statista uses ServiceNow) and IT asset management tools (Statista uses Snipe-IT)

- Nice to have: experience with Jamf, macOS, iOS management

- Fluent English skills. German is a plus.

- Hands-on, solution-oriented mindset with a strong focus on delivering great user experiences

- Proactive communication style and service-oriented attitude

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

- Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

- Hybrid work and flex-time

- International team and social events

- Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

- Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

- Career & training opportunities

- Attractive locations and modern offices

- Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

title: English Language Expert (United States)
description:
Role Title: English Language Expert (United States)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging English Language Experts (United States) to contribute to a specialized audio annotation project focused on American English. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Contributors will work with diverse conversational audio, focusing on the rich variety of American English dialects and accents. Backgrounds in teaching, transcription, editing, translation, journalism, or other language-focused domains are especially valued. A passion for both written and verbal communication is essential as you'll be working to ensure accuracy, clarity, and authenticity in all audio and transcript data.
Scope of Work

• Listen to multi-speaker conversational audio and assess linguistic content for annotation purposes.

• Tag audio samples and speakers with relevant metadata, including dialect, accent, speaking style, age, quality, and background noise.

• Review and correct automated speech recognition (ASR) transcripts, ensuring alignment with American English spelling and usage.

• Identify and annotate regional and cultural language variants, such as Southern English, AAVE, New York City English, Midwestern English and others.

• Leverage your familiarity with American idioms, slang, and vocabulary to validate and enrich transcript data.

Preferred Qualifications

• Fluency in American English, with a strong grasp of US dialects and pronunciation subtleties.

• Experience in linguistics, language teaching, transcription, editing, translation, or journalism.

• Keen ear for differentiating and describing regional American accents and cultural language variations.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with meticulous attention to detail.

• Comfort working remotely and independently on digital platforms.

• Familiarity with American English spelling conventions, idioms, and informal expressions.

• Previous experience with audio annotation or transcription projects is a plus.
